note: PROSPECTIVE (Expansion 19, PROS-19, wip/expansion19-preparation): NPC judgment and decision weighting. Every number here is a PROVISIONAL agent default for isolated tests, NOT an owner decision; the open owner questions SJD-Q01..Q14 are named beside the values they would set (docs/expansion19/DESIGN.md). Points are integer milli-points (1000 = 1 point) and fractions integer permille (1000 = 1.0), so replay and saves are exact. enabled is false: nothing in the live game reads or writes judgment unless a test turns it on.
_events_note: The event catalog (spec s.3; SJD-Q12 what is worth scoring). polarity GOOD or BAD (the owner's rule); NEUTRAL types exist only for memory and post no points, and are refused unless neutral_events is true (SJD-Q01, open). severity: milli-points (spec seed values: minor help 0.5, theft 1, rescue 2, killing 3). min_value: a theft or trade below this many coins of goods is not scored. ambiguous: prior judgment may bias how it is read (SJD-Q05).
_interpret_note: Signed interpretation P in permille (spec s.4). Hierarchical priority for direct effect: the victim of a BAD event or the beneficiary of a GOOD one reads it at affected; the actor's partner in a BAD deed at accomplice; others by their tie to the affected party (kin, friend, else bystander), reversed to rival when they judge the affected party at or below rival_net_at milli-points. Loyalty to the actor (kin_of_actor, friend_of_actor permille factors) softens the reading (SJD-Q08). prior_bias: on ambiguous events only, never for the affected party, P moves by net(observer, actor) * bias_permille_per_point / 1000, at most cap (SJD-Q05).
_belief_note: Provenance and confidence (spec s.6; SJD-Q06 multiplier, threshold or separate layer). confidence_policy: multiplier (impact = S x P x C), threshold (C below confidence_threshold posts nothing, otherwise S x P) or both. Firsthand sources (participant, witnessed) start at their own confidence; told: the teller's confidence x hop_factor x credibility (credibility_base, moved by the listener's judgment of the teller credibility_permille_per_point, within credibility_min..1000). A belief told on from a told belief is a rumour.
_memory_note: Personal memory (bounded, decaying; SJD-Q02, Q11). capacity: memories one person keeps; salience starts at the event's severity x confidence (a NEUTRAL fact at neutral_salience) and fades salience_fade_permille a day; under forget_below it is forgotten. Events of at least permanent_severity never fade (they can still be pushed out when every memory is permanent). Forgetting a memory does NOT take back its judgment points (retract_on_forget false: lifetime GOOD and BAD totals are kept, spec s.5.2) unless the owner decides otherwise. horizon_days: how long an event can still be told or corrected; after it, the dedup key is retired with the fact, so no event can count twice. effective_fade_permille: an optional recent view of GOOD and BAD fading a day (0: off; the spec forbids automatic decay without the owner). dawn_slices: the daily update is spread over this many hours from dawn (an engineering setting: the result is the same however it is sliced).
_gossip_note: Information sharing (SJD-Q07). When two people spend time together each tells the other up to per_meeting of their most salient memories the other does not hold, at most daily_budget tellings a teller a day, never beyond max_hops from a firsthand source, and never a memory under min_confidence. A teller only shares with someone whose judgment of them is above share_net_at. misattribute_permille: the chance (a seeded hash, not World.rng) that a rumour names the wrong actor (0: off). pump_per_tick: queued meetings told each World tick (an engineering setting: the result is the same whatever the pace). timing: "hour" (an hour's meetings count as told at its start, as before; told over the next ticks with identical results) or "scheduled" (each meeting told at its own seeded minute of the hour: smaller frames, different results; a design option, off).
_decision_note: Decision weighting (spec s.7; SJD-Q03, Q04, Q09, Q13). The live decision code supplies the feasible candidates and their factor values (0..100000: milli-points on the spec's 0..100 scale); judgment adds one factor, disposition = 50 points + NET, clamped to 0..100 points (the spec's worked example: NET -6.59 -> 43.41), weighted like any other. utility = sum(weight permille x factor) / 1000. ambivalence = min(GOOD, BAD), clamped to 0..100 points (SJD-Q04; weight 0). live_order: the live code's own order of preference (first 100 points, 10 less for each after), so with every judgment neutral the live choice stands and any change is judgment's (price weight 0 until calibrated). forgo: the utility of doing without (a purchase must beat it). selection: argmax (ties to the lowest id) or margin (a seeded pick among options within margin of the best). trait_spread_permille: per-person weight differences from the seed (0: everyone weighs alike).
